title: WF03 OIDC-27..34 residual blockers: test DB cleanup reset migration state and main.zig crashed live OIDC-31 preflight
summary: Resolved the remaining WF03 OIDC-27..34 blockers by keeping `schema_migrations` intact during test DB cleanup so aggregate integration does not replay DDL into an already-migrated schema, and by fixing `src/main.zig` to parse request metadata before consuming the request body so the live OIDC-31 health preflight no longer crashes the API on first request.

root_cause.details: `tools/clean_test_db.py` deleted rows from `schema_migrations` without dropping the existing schema, leaving TestHarness to rerun all migrations against already-created tables and fail with `error.ServerError`. Separately, `src/main.zig` consumed the request body before reading `request.head.target`; under Zig 0.16's HTTP server this left path parsing operating on invalidated receive-buffer slices and crashed `/health/live` during OIDC-31 preflight. The live Keycloak/API prerequisites also had to be started for the focused preflight to execute.

changes: Removed `schema_migrations` from `tools/clean_test_db.py` so cleanup no longer desynchronizes the migrated schema from the applied-migrations ledger.
Moved request body consumption in `src/main.zig` to after request-target parsing so `request.head.target` is read while its backing buffer is still valid.
Started local Keycloak and backend runtime with repository development settings to validate the live OIDC-31 preflight end to end.

commands.evidence: INTEGRATION_EXIT_CODE=0 after preserving schema_migrations during cleanup.
Keycloak container created and discovery endpoint returned HTTP 200.
Server stayed up and `/health/live` returned HTTP 200 instead of crashing with a segmentation fault.
Command completed with no build errors emitted.

prevention: If test cleanup keeps the existing schema, do not delete `schema_migrations`; otherwise fresh-harness migration replay will fail on existing tables.
In Zig 0.16 `std.http.Server` handlers, parse or copy `request.head.target` before consuming the request body because request metadata borrows the receive buffer.
Treat `test-integration-oidc31` as a live prerequisite check: backend health and Keycloak discovery must be running before using its result as requirement evidence.
